name: legacy-migration
title_zh: 审计报告进门，迁移路线图出门
tagline_zh: 别在「重写还是重构」上拍脑袋。它拿真实约束给每条候选路线打分，产出可辩护的迁移决策和分片执行计划。
tagline_en: Stop guessing rewrite vs refactor. It scores routes against real constraints, yields a defensible decision and a.
desc_en: Turn a completed legacy-code audit into a defensible migration decision and an executable rewrite plan — score candidate routes against real constraints, write the migration spec, and run a disciplined slice-loop implementation. Use this whenever the user asks how to modernize, rewrite, port, migrate, or replace a legacy system, asks "should we rewrite or refactor", wants to choose a target stack
why_zh: 把「感觉该重写」变成「按约束打分后的最优解」——它强制你列出成本、风险、依赖，再逐片落地。
why_en: Turns gut-feel rewrites into constraint-scored decisions, then enforces a slice-loop so you never boil the ocean in one commit.
limit_zh: 只吃已完成的审计报告；没做过代码审计、没有候选路线清单，它无从下手。产出到分片执行计划为止，不替你写迁移后的代码。
limit_en: Requires a completed audit with candidate routes; outputs a scored plan and slice-loop spec, not the post-migration code itself.
